implementation_strategy: Execute preregistered paired confirmatory scenario via the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter: 200 deterministic challenging_workflow_stress_v1 indices (fixed pre-execution), one shared initial generation call per task (baseline+guarded share initial candidate semantics), and up to one guarded repair call per task; all scoring and validator computations performed autonomously by adapter-provided deterministic scoring executors; record runtime sampling parameters and provider metadata in execution manifest.
task_manifest_strategy: Use adapter-prescribed deterministic challenging_workflow_stress_v1 index rule to produce 200 task indices (5 offsets per 8-task cycle; cycles 0..39). Task definitions and allowed-action sets taken from hosted_netops_gvr_v1 episodes; first 20 task_indices (first 20 by list order) archived with extra telemetry.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (one generation call). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 (initial generation + at most one repair call if deterministic validators fail). Repairs that violate deterministic mapping or allowed-action rules are treated per preregistered automatic_rejection_rules.
execution_batches: single batch: process the 200 deterministic task_indices in ascending order; record per-task timestamps and HTTP/provider metadata
randomisation_plan: No randomisation of task indices (deterministic adapter-prescribed selection). Runtime model sampling parameters follow provider defaults; record seeds/temperatures in execution manifest.
caching_plan: Cache no model outputs for reuse across tasks; store all raw outputs and hashes in artifact storage for reproducibility.
failure_recovery_plan: No manual retries (maximum_attempts_per_call=1). Infrastructure/provider errors logged and counted per missingness_plan; primary analysis uses complete pairs only; sensitivity analysis treats missing guarded episodes as failures (0).
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (version 1.0) as provided by adapter contract; contains per-episode: task_index, condition, raw_model_output, deterministic_validator_trace, binary_success_label, detection_latency_ms, model_call_metadata, output_sha256.
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call budget: exactly task_count * 2 = 400 maximum model calls. Estimated wall time within hosted API limits and capability manifest (cpu_execution_available false for local GPU; use hosted API). All totals arithmetic-checked: 200 tasks × 1 initial generation = 200 calls; up to 200 guarded repairs = 200 calls → maximum 400 calls (set as estimated and maximum).
